name: Zero
source:
One may say this poltergeist is short-tempered. Honestly speaking, it's just Fay's personality that's taking years off his undead life.

Still, Zero would float a thousand miles and more for his childhood friend...

[From [url=https://nifty-visuals.itch.io/witches-x-warlocks]itch.io[/url]]
